current_point.claim: 提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a new distributed graph neural network training framework based on graph summarization, called DSGNN.
technical_features: 由一个领导节点和若干工作者节点构成
在工作节点上对子图进行小批量样本的学习
使用图摘要技术生成子图
technical_features_en: Consists of a leader node and several worker nodes
Performs mini-batch sample learning on subgraphs at worker nodes
Generates subgraphs using graph summarization technology
